Storm hits the coast

By Jane Doe and John Roe

12 November 2026

A powerful storm made landfall on the northern coast overnight, bringing winds of more than 150 kilometres per hour and cutting power to tens of thousands of homes across the region. Emergency services said they had received hundreds of calls before dawn.

The national weather service had issued its highest warning level on Wednesday afternoon, urging residents of low-lying areas to move to higher ground. Officials said evacuation centres in twelve towns were operating at capacity by midnight.

Forecasters expect the storm to weaken as it moves inland, but heavy rain is likely to continue through the weekend. Read the full forecast or see more world news.
